rules.name: Base unit of measure MEINS must reference a valid entry in T006
rules.why: UoM conversions fail; stock quantities cannot be resolved; costing and CO-PA calculations error.

rules.name: Material type is mandatory - determines procurement and storage behaviour
rules.why: Material cannot be created or used in MM, PP, SD, or FI without a valid material type.

rules.name: Material group is required for reporting and procurement
rules.why: Spend analysis and procurement reporting are incomplete.

rules.name: Gross weight is recommended for shipping and transportation planning
rules.why: Transportation planning and load building produce incorrect results.

rules.name: Externally procured, MRP-planned material has no purchasing group
rules.why: Requisitions from MRP land without a purchasing group; they are not picked up by buyer worklists (ME57) and release strategies keyed on purchasing group do not apply.

rules.name: MRP type (plant level) must exist in T438A
rules.why: MRP run (MD01/MD01N) skips materials with invalid types.

rules.name: Valuation class is mandatory for FI account determination
rules.why: All goods movements (MIGO) fail with account determination errors.

rules.name: Procurement type must be E (in-house), F (external), or X (both)
